notes: Template: TBox contraction, paired with history-replace-0005. Removes the revision's original fact (every Roman amphitheatre was built for gladiatorial combat), which every model holds. Its own questions (direct, paraphrase, cross-lingual, propositional) expect does-not-know; under strong Kleene logic the three propositional answers are unknown. The three derived queries name provincial amphitheatres in the prompt as Roman amphitheatres and ask what they were built to host, an open question so the answer is not in the prompt: before, the rule gives gladiatorial combat (inheritance, 2 hops); after, nothing does. The famous members (Colosseum, Pula) are not asked because a model may hold their purpose by name. Direct, paraphrase, cross-lingual, near and far queries and the side facts are those of the revision, which were audited. The edit is the same rule the revision changes, so the paired records share facts by design (Rule 14). Wikipedia was not re-read for the Cemenelum and Lambaesis bridges (rate limit).
